name: Boolean truth workspace
summary: Enumerate two-input AND, OR, XOR and NAND.
assumptions: Two Boolean inputs; all four assignments; no arbitrary formula or K-map drawing grader.

name: Representation workspace
summary: Decode signed fixed point and a declared custom float.
assumptions: Custom float: hidden leading 1, all exponent codes ordinary, no zero/subnormal/infinity/NaN. Fixed point uses an explicitly chosen signed interpretation.

name: Assembly Visualizer
assumptions: The existing supported qword instruction subset and sparse aligned memory model are unchanged. Partial-register examples in Learn are reading-only.

name: Instruction bit-budget workspace
summary: Allocate register/address fields and count remaining opcodes.
assumptions: Fixed instruction length, explicit field counts, no reserved opcode codes unless the learner accounts for them separately.

name: Address alias workspace
summary: Enumerate addresses differing only on ignored decoder bits.
assumptions: Eight-bit byte addresses in the interface; bit 0 is the least significant bit. No timing or physical wiring is inferred.

name: Memory organization workspace
summary: Separate chip width/depth and low-order bank mapping.
assumptions: Non-multiplexed address/data pins, excluding power/control; exact whole-chip organization; bank mapping uses word addresses.

name: Cache trace workspace
summary: Step through set/tag lookup and LRU replacement.
assumptions: Initially empty, read-only, read-allocate, true LRU; tags listed least to most recent. No writes, timing or hierarchy simulation.

name: Pipeline timing workspace
summary: Compare a fixed dependency sequence with and without forwarding.
assumptions: Five equal stages F,D,X,M,W; in order; fetch waits; separate stage resources; same-cycle W-to-D register access; no branches or speculation.

name: Amdahl workspace
summary: Compare serial time, processor count and speedup limits.
assumptions: Fixed original workload; ideal scaling of only the parallel fraction; zero communication/coordination overhead.

name: Virtual-memory workspace
summary: Split a virtual address, check a supplied page entry and translate.
assumptions: Flat one-level page table; byte addresses; explicit present/write permission; no TLB, page replacement or OS fault-handler model.
